payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes bitwise OR of all elements in a and b, then sums them. Exploits monotonicity of OR to reduce the problem to a single full-array computation.
payload.rationale: The solution uses straightforward bitwise OR accumulation, which falls under bit manipulation rather than search. Chosen subtype 'bit_binary_representation' is the closest generic bitwise category, though the code does not explicitly convert to binary. Family mismatch because candidate_families is ['complete_search'].
